wins.text: Record equities net revenues of $4.2 billion in Q1, with equities intermediation up 28% YoY driven by strong derivatives performance
FICC and equities combined financing revenues reached a record $2.7 billion, up 22% YoY — fifth consecutive quarter of record financing revenues
Assets under supervision rose to a record $3.2 trillion, with 29th consecutive quarter of long-term fee-based net inflows of $29 billion
Record common stock repurchases of $4.4 billion in Q1, with Board authorizing a new multiyear $40 billion share repurchase program
Total wealth management revenue grew 11% YoY to $2.2 billion; client assets reached a record $1.6 trillion

risks.text: GS economists cut U.S. growth forecast from over 2% to 0.5%, with recession probability rising materially amid trade war escalation fears
Advisory revenues of $792 million were down YoY; investment banking activity more muted than expected coming into the year due to policy uncertainty
April 2 tariff shock created significant market dislocation; management acknowledged record prime brokerage balances could decline as clients deleverage, pressuring financing revenues
Alternatives fee rate contracted meaningfully (to ~61 bps) driven by lower-fee OCIO mandates, with difficult monetization environment pressuring incentive fees
~$150 million severance charge expected in Q2 related to annual performance management and pyramid restructuring actions

guidance_items.detail: High single-digit annual growth expected in durable revenues (management fees + private banking & lending, totaling $3.4B in Q1)
Alternatives fundraising expected to be in line with recent years, though could be impacted by market conditions
HPI portfolio expected to be substantially sold down by end of 2026, from ~$8.8B currently
~$150M severance charge guided for Q2 related to pyramid restructuring actions — new cost item not previously flagged
Full-year effective tax rate guided at approximately 21%

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Impact of April 2 tariff shock and early Q2 client deleveraging on financing and trading revenues
Competitive market share dynamics in trading vs. peers in Q1
Risk of international/cross-border revenue sourcing being impacted by U.S. policy volatility and geopolitical tensions
